content:
The new Apple TV 4K is about to go on sale, and is expected to debut at the iPhone launch event in a few weeks. Apple code discovered by MacRumors has leaked information about a new Siri Remote.

macOS code mentions the next-generation Apple TV remote

Apple released a series of public and beta software updates yesterday. The macOS 26.7 RC mentions a number of unannounced products.

For example, MacRumors discovered a video showing AirPods with cameras actually in operation.

The new Siri Remote for the Apple TV 4K also appears in this list of unreleased products. Juli Clover writes:

Mark Gurman previously reported that this hardware update would 'likely feature an improved Apple TV remote.'

The discovery of this next-generation Siri Remote in macOS 26.7 means the new remote will indeed launch this fall.

There are no rumors yet about specific changes to the remote. However, one common feature request is to make it easier to find a lost remote. The second-generation ultra-wideband chip used in the AirTag 2 may be incorporated into the Siri Remote.

What changes would you like to see in the new Siri Remote for the next-generation Apple TV 4K? Feel free to let us know in the comments.
